title: IoT-Smart-Energy
summary: A student project attempting to build a smart energy metering system using IoT sensors and machine learning. A notebook named sdv.ipynb only imports the SDV package and inspects its contents, with commented-out code for PAR and TimeSeriesGAN synthesizers that was never executed.
evidence: sdv.ipynb:17 'import sdv\nprint(dir(sdv))'; PAR/TimeSeriesGAN import commented out at line 32
needs: Only a bare import and dir() call are executed; PAR/TimeSeriesGAN usage is commented out, so no actual synthesizer call could be verified.
